findings.title: Missing Schema.org Organization structured data on root landing page
findings.evidence:
Observed at https://www.djangoproject.com/ via jsonld_schema_extractor [2026-08-31T16:43:17Z]: Root homepage contains 0 Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema blocks. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (citation-simulator): Observed at https://www.djangoproject.com via onsite_answerability_probe [2026-08-31T16:43:18Z]: Across 5 crawled page(s), no Organization/LocalBusiness schema states who the brand is in machine-readable form. An assistant that fetched these pages could not quote an answer to "What is Django Project?" from this site, so it must fall back to third-party sources or omit the brand. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD markup to the homepage.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a JSON-LD script on the homepage declaring @type 'Organization' with name, url, logo, and sameAs links to authoritative profiles.

evidence_details.observation: Root homepage contains 0 Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema blocks.

proactive_recommendations.title: Add Schema.org FAQPage markup to enrich AI assistant direct answers
proactive_recommendations.rationale: The site contains informative Q&A or FAQ text. Adding structured FAQPage JSON-LD allows search engines and generative AI agents to quote verbatim answers directly in response to user inquiries.

suggested_action.summary: Implement Schema.org FAQPage structured data on help and FAQ sections.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Wrap top customer questions in a JSON-LD script declaring @type 'FAQPage' with 'mainEntity' Question and acceptedAnswer Answer objects.

proactive_recommendations.title: Publish an llms.txt file to guide AI assistants to authoritative documentation
proactive_recommendations.rationale: Emerging AI web standards like /llms.txt provide large language models with a curated, markdown-formatted directory of core brand documentation and APIs.

suggested_action.summary: Create an llms.txt file in the root web directory.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add an /llms.txt file containing markdown links to your primary product, documentation, pricing, and company overview pages.
